content.description: Manifold gauge set with two pressure gauges marked 'Close', showing connection points to HI and LO valves, and discharge/suction service valves

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Close the HI and LO hand valves.

subitems.label: (b)
subitems.text: Connect the high pressure hose to the discharge service valve of the compressor.

subitems.label: (c)
subitems.text: Connect the low pressure hose to the suction service valve of the compressor.

items.title: CHECK COMPRESSOR FOR FOLLOWING:

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: High pressure gauge reading is not low and low pressure gauge reading is not higher than normal.

items.note: If defects are found, repair the compressor.

items.title: CHECK MAGNETIC CLUTCH

subitems.label: (a)
subitems.text: Inspect the pressure plate and the rotor for signs of oil.

subitems.label: (b)
subitems.text: Check the clutch bearings for noise and grease leakage.

subitems.label: (c)
subitems.text: Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance of the stator coil between the clutch lead wire and ground.

items.note: If the resistance is not within tolerance, replace the coil.
